{{Quote|Be fair, you know the mining business wasn't the only attraction for me.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 83">[[Star Wars (1977) 83|''Star Wars'' (1977) 83]]</ref>}}
'''Drogheda Mining Company''' was a local corporation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]] run by the ruling family of the world. Their main mining operation was out of the [[Mount Meru Mine]], and during the [[Drogheda Civil War]], the mine was captured by the [[Drogheda Revolutionaries]], hindering the profits of the company. The company was headed by [[Sarna's father]] during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and several years later, during the civil war, his daughter, [[Sarna (Queen)|Sarna]] was the head of the company.
